title: Full Stack Developer
description: Build scalable, responsive web applications from interactive user interfaces down to secure server APIs and databases.

roadmap.title: Core Web Technologies
roadmap.details: HTML semantics, CSS flexbox/grid, JavaScript DOM manipulation, ES6 syntax, and asynchronous JS (Promises/async-await).

roadmap.title: React Ecosystem
roadmap.details: Component composition, React Hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo), state management, routing, and responsive UI design.

roadmap.title: Server-Side Development
roadmap.details: Building REST APIs with Node.js and Express, database schema design with SQL/MongoDB, authentication, and JWT tokens.

roadmap.title: Production Deployment
roadmap.details: CI/CD fundamentals, containerizing apps with Docker, hosting on Vercel/Render/AWS, and end-to-end full stack capstone projects.

title: Data Analyst / AI Engineer
description: Transform raw datasets into actionable business intelligence and design machine learning models that automate complex decisions.

roadmap.title: Python & Relational Databases
roadmap.details: Master Python data structures, SQL queries, relational database normalization, joins, aggregations, and window functions.

roadmap.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
roadmap.details: Data cleaning, wrangling with Pandas and NumPy, handling missing values, outlier detection, and statistical correlation.

roadmap.title: Dashboards & Business Metrics
roadmap.details: Building interactive visualizations with Seaborn, Matplotlib, PowerBI or Tableau to communicate insights to stakeholders.

roadmap.title: Predictive Modeling
roadmap.details: Supervised/unsupervised learning with Scikit-Learn, regression, classification, clustering, model evaluation, and modern LLM APIs.

title: Cloud & DevOps Specialist
description: Design reliable cloud architectures, automate software deployments, and manage scalable containerized infrastructure.

roadmap.title: Linux & Computer Networking
roadmap.details: Linux directory hierarchy, file permissions, bash scripting, process management, TCP/IP, OSI layers, DNS, and SSH.

roadmap.title: Docker Containers
roadmap.details: Writing Dockerfiles, building multi-stage container images, container networking, volumes, and multi-container Docker Compose setups.

roadmap.title: Public Cloud Platforms
roadmap.details: Core AWS/Azure services (EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS), security policies, load balancers, and cloud cost management.

roadmap.title: CI/CD & Kubernetes
roadmap.details: Automated build/test/deploy pipelines using GitHub Actions, Kubernetes cluster pods, deployments, services, and monitoring.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Defend enterprise computer networks, identify vulnerabilities, perform security audits, and safeguard sensitive student and business data.

roadmap.title: Security & Network Principles
roadmap.details: Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability (CIA triad), packet analysis with Wireshark, routing protocols, firewalls, and VPNs.

roadmap.title: Penetration Testing & Scanning
roadmap.details: Network reconnaissance with Nmap, vulnerability scanning, security configuration assessment, and analyzing open ports.

roadmap.title: OWASP Top 10 Defense
roadmap.details: Understanding web vulnerabilities (SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, broken access control), secure coding, and API security.

roadmap.title: Threat Monitoring & Compliance
roadmap.details: SIEM log analysis, intrusion detection (IDS/IPS), security incident triage, disaster recovery, and compliance frameworks.
